faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Saloneo

free.q: Is the free account really free for life?
free.a: Yes! Our free account is 100% free, with no time limit. You can use it as long as you want. No credit card required to start.

limits.q: What are the limits of the free account?
limits.a: The free account includes 20 appointments per month, 10 clients maximum and 5 services. Perfect to discover Saloneo. You can upgrade anytime to unlock more features.

upgrade.q: Can I upgrade my account later?
upgrade.a: Absolutely! You can upgrade to a higher plan anytime. The change is immediate and you only pay the prorated difference.

security.a: Yes, security is our priority. All your data is encrypted and hosted on secure servers. We comply with the strictest security standards.

support.q: What type of support do you offer?
support.a: We offer email support for all accounts. Paid plans benefit from priority support with faster response times.

cancel.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancel.a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription anytime, without fees or penalties. Your account will remain active until the end of the paid period.

free.q: Does the Free plan need a bank card?
free.a: No. You create your account with an email and a password. The Free plan limits (20 appointments a month, 10 clients, 5 services) are enough to try Saloneo.

payment.q: How do I pay for a subscription?
payment.a: By CIB or Edahabia card, through the secure SATIM gateway, from the Subscription page of your account.

change.a: Yes. Upgrade whenever you like from the Subscription page. Your appointments, clients and services are kept.

limit.q: What happens if I reach a limit?
limit.a: Saloneo lets you know. Your data stays intact; to add more, simply move to the next plan.

yearly.a: You pay for twelve months at once and pay {{discount}}% less than monthly. Two- and three-year terms also exist, with a larger discount.

data.q: Who can access my salon's data?
data.a: You and the people on your team. Traffic between your device and Saloneo is encrypted (HTTPS).
